hint.en: How often this device polls the Viessmann API. The free Basic tier allows 120 calls per day per Client ID — keep this high enough that calls/day × devices stays under that limit.
Estimated standby power draw when the compressor is OFF (circulator pump, controller, etc.). Used to compute live measure_power when no kWh delta is available.

Estimated electrical draw of the compressor at its maximum speed (typically ~120 rps for inverter heat pumps). Live measure_power is scaled linearly from compressor.speed when the compressor is active. Tune to match what the Viessmann ViCare app shows during a steady-state cycle. Set to 0 to disable the compressor-based estimate and fall back to kWh-delta derivation.
